menu.destinations.title: Destinations
help.text:
TgJelly sends Jellyfin news (new media, security alerts, server events) to your Telegram chats, groups and channels.

/menu: open the menu
/status: see how things are going
/test: send a test message

More settings are on the Jellyfin dashboard: Dashboard → Plugins → Telegram.
status.title: Status
dest.btn.events.about: choose which events this chat receives
dest.btn.libraries.about: limit new-media posts to some libraries
dest.btn.silent.about: deliver some groups without a notification sound
dest.btn.test.about: send a test message to this chat now
dest.btn.check.about: check again that I can still post here
dest.btn.pause.about: stop sending here for now; nothing is deleted
dest.btn.remove.about: stop sending here and forget this chat
dest.btn.removeLeave.about: forget this chat and leave it
dest.events.title: Events
events.choose: Pick a group to switch its events. The numbers show how many are on.
events.group.media.about: new movies, episodes, albums, music videos and books
events.group.security.about: failed and successful sign-ins, lockouts, user and password changes
events.group.server.about: server start, updates, plugins, failed tasks and pending restarts
dest.libraries.title: Libraries
dest.libraries.hint: With no library picked, every library is sent.
dest.libraries.all.about: post new media from every library
dest.silent.title: Silent groups
dest.silent.hint: Messages of a silent group arrive without a notification sound.
dest.remove.ask:
Remove this destination?
Also make the bot leave the chat?
dest.remove.only.about: forget this chat; I stay in it
dest.picker.title: Send a test message to
settings.title: Settings
settings.messages.pick: Tap a switch to turn it on (✅) or off (⬜).
settings.messages.about: what notifications show: poster, overview and buttons
settings.updates.about: turn Jellyfin release checks on or off, and choose which kinds count
settings.url.about: the address the Open in Jellyfin button uses
settings.messages.title: Message style
settings.messages.hint: Pick a section, then a message, then what it shows.
settings.messages.pickMessage: Tap a message to choose what it shows.
settings.messages.none: This message has no switches: it always looks the same.
settings.msg.ShowPoster.about: send the poster (for Security and Server, the TgJelly logo) with the text
settings.msg.ShowOpenInJellyfin.about: add a button that opens the item in Jellyfin
settings.msg.ShowProviderLinks.about: add buttons that open the item on IMDb and TMDb
settings.msg.AnnounceUpgrades.about: also announce when a file is replaced by a better-quality one
settings.updates.kind.Fixes.about: 10.11.1 to 10.11.2, a fix for the version you run
settings.updates.kind.NewReleases.about: 10.11 to 10.12, a new release of the same major version
settings.msg.of.media.digest.about: see the digest, which has no switches
settings.updates.title: Update checks
settings.updates.hint: TgJelly checks for new Jellyfin releases and tells you here. With all three off, no update messages are sent.
settings.updates.enabled.about: look for new releases and tell you here
settings.url.title: Public URL
settings.url.hint: The address people use to reach Jellyfin. It is used for the Open in Jellyfin button.
settings.url.suggested: Suggested: {url} (verify it opens from outside your network)
settings.url.clear.about: remove the address; posts lose the Open in Jellyfin button
settings.url.prompt: Send the public URL as a message.
settings.url.rule: It must start with http:// or https:// and the host needs a dot (jf.example.com or 192.168.1.5). localhost, bare names like jellyfin, and IPv6 addresses don't work in buttons.
onboard.hint: After you choose a chat in Telegram, I'll continue here.
onboard.channel.about: choose one of your channels in Telegram; I join it as an admin who can post and edit
onboard.group.about: choose a group in Telegram; I join it as a member
onboard.here.about: send notifications to this private chat
onboard.detected.about: a chat I'm already in that isn't set up yet
onboard.customDone.about: add the chat with the events you switched on
onboard.preset.newMedia.about: only new movies, episodes, music and books
onboard.preset.adminAlerts.about: security and server alerts, without successful sign-ins
onboard.tryAgain.about: check this chat again after you've fixed it
onboard.advanced.about: other ways to add a chat: an existing topic's link, or the dashboard
topic.ask: This group has topics. Where should I post?
topic.general.about: post in the group's General topic
topic.create.about: I make a new topic called Jellyfin and post there
topic.existing.about: post in a topic you already have; you'll send me its link
topic.allow.about: opens Telegram so you can give me that permission; choose the group and confirm
topic.allowPrompt: To create a topic, I need permission to manage topics in {title}.
topic.checkAgain.about: if you or another admin already gave me the permission, tap this and I'll create the topic
topic.stillNoRights: I still can't manage topics in {title}.
topic.otherGroup: You changed my rights in {other}, not in {title}.
topic.linkPrompt: Send me the topic's link as a message. Long-press the topic → Copy link.
topic.wrongChat: That topic is in a different chat than the one you picked.
topic.failed: I couldn't set up a topic there. You can post in the General topic instead.

Advanced options

If the usual setup didn't work, you can add a chat another way.
advanced.topic.about: post in a topic you already have; you'll send me its link
advanced.dashboard.about: add a chat by its ID in the Jellyfin dashboard
advanced.dashboardPath: Dashboard → Plugins → Telegram → Advanced → Add chat by ID
templates.willShorten: will be shortened when sent with a poster
templates.tooLong: The message is {length} characters; Telegram allows at most {limit}.
templates.emptyWarning: With some of the sample values this template produces no text. Then the built-in template is used instead.
templates.html.blockquote: A blockquote may only have the attribute expandable
web.nav.label: Sections
web.status.title: Status
web.status.counts: Waiting for metadata: {pending} · Queued to send: {outbox} · Dropped: {dropped}
web.connect.title: Connect a Telegram bot
web.connect.step2: In BotFather's Mini App, restrict access to yourself and anyone else who should manage Jellyfin (up to 10 people).
web.connect.step3: Copy the token and paste it below.
web.connect.noteRestrict: Restrict access in BotFather if you haven't, because anyone who can open the bot can manage notifications.
web.connect.noteOther: Don't use this bot in another program at the same time.
web.connect.setProfile: Let TgJelly set up this bot's profile: description, command menu and default admin rights (replaces the current ones)
web.connect.webhookRemoved: A webhook that was set for this bot has been removed.
web.connect.unreachableHint: If this server needs a proxy to reach Telegram, set it here and save the token again.
web.bot.title: Bot
web.bot.name: Username
web.bot.access: Anyone who can open this bot can manage notifications. Keep it restricted in BotFather.
web.bot.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect this bot? Notifications stop until you connect a bot.
web.bot.disconnect.removeHint: Off keeps your destinations for the next bot. On removes them and their queued messages.
web.proxy.title: Proxy
web.proxy.typesHint: Only SOCKS5 and HTTP proxies work for bots. MTProto proxies are for Telegram apps, not bots.
web.dest.title: Destinations
web.dest.empty: No destinations yet. Add one to start getting notifications.
web.dest.librariesRemoved: Every library this destination was limited to has been removed, so nothing is sent. Remove the leftovers below and it receives all libraries again, or pick libraries.
web.dest.conflictPlain: This destination changed elsewhere. Its current state is shown; try again.
web.dest.presetConfirm: Replace your custom events with this preset?
web.manual.title: Add chat by ID
web.manual.label: Chat ID or topic link
web.manual.AlreadyExists: This chat is already a destination.
web.messages.title: Choose a message
web.messages.intro: Each message has its own switches and template. Pick one to set it up; the preview shows it as Telegram will.
web.messages.logoHint: Sends the TgJelly logo with the text.
web.messages.announceHint: Also announce when a file is replaced by a better-quality one. This applies to all media messages.
web.messages.urlHint: The address people use to reach Jellyfin. It is one setting for every message's Open in Jellyfin button.
web.messages.verify: Verify that it opens from outside your network.
web.messages.urlInvalid: This URL can't be used, so the buttons that link to Jellyfin are left out of messages. A public URL must start with http:// or https://, have a host name with a dot (such as jellyfin.example.com), and not be an IPv6 address.
web.batching.title: Batching
web.batching.quiet.label: Quiet window (seconds)
web.batching.quiet.hint: How long to wait after the last new item before sending a group ({min} to {max}).
web.batching.maxHold.label: Longest hold (minutes)
web.batching.maxHold.hint: The longest a group waits before it is sent, however busy the library is ({min} to {max}; at least the quiet window).
web.batching.releaseQuiet.label: Release pause (seconds)
web.batching.releaseQuiet.hint: How long no new group may arrive before a library scan's groups are released ({min} to {max}).
web.batching.digest.label: Digest threshold (groups)
web.batching.digest.hint: A scan with more groups than this is sent as one digest ({min} to {max}).
web.batching.lateEdit.label: Late additions (hours)
web.batching.lateEdit.hint: New items for a group already sent within this many hours are added to its message ({min} to {max}; 0 = never edit).
web.batching.readyTimeout.label: Metadata wait (minutes)
web.batching.readyTimeout.hint: How long to wait for an item's metadata before sending it as it is ({min} to {max}).
web.updates.title: Update checks
web.updates.fixesHint: For example 10.11.1 to 10.11.2: the same first two numbers, a higher third.
web.updates.newReleasesHint: For example 10.11 to 10.12: the same first number, a higher second.
web.updates.newMajorHint: For example 10.x to 12.0: a higher first number.
web.settings.maxHoldShort: Must be at least as long as the quiet window.
web.diag.title: Diagnostics
web.diag.contains: The report lists: the TgJelly and Jellyfin versions, the operating system and .NET runtime; the bot's connection state, username and whether a token is set; the proxy mode and its host and port; settings (public URL set and valid, which messages differ from their default switches, batching values, update checks); each destination's kind, preset, health and counts; which templates are edited; the outbox and pending counts; the last errors; and any load warnings.
web.diag.never: The bot token is never included, nor proxy credentials, chat IDs or chat names. The Log is not part of the report (its last errors already are).
web.diag.why: It exists so you can paste it into a bug report or a support request.
web.diag.manual: Copying failed. Select the text below and copy it yourself.
web.templates.title: Template
web.templates.intro: The bot writes this message from this template. Change a word or a line and the preview follows.
web.templates.flagError: This template failed when a message was sent, so the built-in template was used instead:
web.templates.flagTruncated: This template made a message too long for Telegram, so the message was shortened.
web.tables.insert: Insert into the template at the cursor
web.format.spoiler: Hides the text until someone taps it.
web.format.a: A link. Write the full address, starting with https://.
web.format.code: Monospaced text that Telegram copies when tapped.
web.format.pre: A monospaced block that keeps its line breaks.
web.format.quote: A quote with a bar on its left.
web.format.quoteExpandable: A quote that shows its first line and opens to show the rest.
web.format.if: Shows the text only when the field has a value. Add {{ else }} before the end for the other case.
web.format.plural: Picks the word that fits the number n: the first for 1, the second otherwise.
web.format.raw: Prints a value as it is, without escaping its tags. Use it only for text you trust.
web.format.trim: Removes the line break and spaces before a tag ({{-) or after it (-}}).
web.templates.testNote: The test message goes to that chat for real, and its members see it.
web.templates.noDestinations: Add a destination to send a test message.
web.templates.resetAsk: Reset? Your edits to this template are lost.
web.templates.conflict: The templates changed on the server. Your unsaved text is kept on top of the new data; check it and try again.
web.log.why.libraryExcluded: This destination doesn't get the {library} library
web.log.why.libraryUnknown: This destination gets only some libraries, and Jellyfin didn't say which library this item is in
web.log.why.itemGone: It was removed from Jellyfin before its details were ready, so there was nothing to announce
web.log.why.itemsGone: Its items were removed from Jellyfin before the message went out
web.log.why.upgrade: It replaces a copy that was already announced, and announcing upgrades is off
web.log.why.destinationRemoved: The destination was removed before the message went out
web.log.why.collecting: Held briefly in case more items arrive, so they go out together
web.log.why.collectingEpisodes: Collecting more episodes of this season, so they go out in one message
web.log.why.held.Lost: Held: the bot was removed from this chat or blocked. It goes out once the destination works again
web.log.why.held.NeedsPermissions: Held: the bot lacks the {right} permission here. It goes out once the destination works again
web.log.why.held.TopicMissing: Held: the topic this destination posts to was deleted. It goes out once the destination works again
web.log.why.builtIn: Your edited template failed ({error}), so the built-in one was used
web.log.why.noPhoto.blocked: This chat doesn't allow photos, so the text was sent alone
web.log.why.noPhoto.rejected: Telegram rejected the poster image, so the text was sent alone
web.log.why.noPhoto.unreadable: The poster file couldn't be read, so the text was sent alone
web.log.why.noPhoto.upload: Uploading the poster kept failing, so the text was sent alone
web.log.why.lateRetried: Couldn't get through to Telegram for {delay} ({error}), sent on try {tries}
web.log.why.retry.ServerError: Telegram had a server error, trying again
web.log.why.retry.Unauthorized: Telegram rejected the bot token, trying again
web.log.why.retry.RateLimited: Telegram asked TgJelly to slow down, waiting before sending
web.log.why.failed.Lost: Telegram refused it: the bot was removed from the chat or blocked
web.log.why.failed.NeedsPermissions: Telegram refused it: the bot lacks the {right} permission
web.log.why.failed.TopicMissing: Telegram refused it: the topic this destination posts to was deleted
web.log.why.failed.Migrated: Telegram refused it: the group became a supergroup, and TgJelly couldn't move the destination there
web.log.why.failed.fallbacks: Telegram refused it even without the poster, buttons and formatting: {error}
web.log.why.failed.expired: It couldn't be delivered within 24 hours, so it was dropped
web.log.advice.Lost: Add the bot back to {destination}, then press Check again on the destination. Messages wait up to 24 hours and go out once it's back.
web.log.advice.NeedsPermissions: Give the bot the {right} permission in {destination}, then press Check again on the destination. Messages wait up to 24 hours and go out once it can post.
web.log.advice.TopicMissing: Set {destination} up again in the bot with an existing or a new topic, then remove the old destination.
web.log.advice.Migrated: Set the new supergroup up as a destination in the bot, then remove {destination}.
web.log.advice.Other: Telegram's answer is shown above. If it is about the message's text, check this message's template on the Messages page; otherwise press Copy diagnostics in Advanced and include it in a bug report.
web.log.advice.Transport: Check that the Jellyfin server can reach api.telegram.org, and the proxy in Advanced. TgJelly keeps trying for 24 hours.
web.log.advice.ServerError: Nothing to do: Telegram's servers had a problem. TgJelly keeps trying for 24 hours.
web.log.advice.Unauthorized: Telegram no longer accepts the bot token. Get the current token from @BotFather and paste it with Change token on the Overview page. TgJelly keeps trying for 24 hours.
web.log.advice.RateLimited: Nothing to do: TgJelly waits as long as Telegram asks, then sends.
web.log.advice.expired: Check this destination on the Destinations page and Telegram's answer above. New messages go out once the problem is fixed.
web.log.advice.builtIn: Fix the edited template on the Messages page; its error is shown there too. Until then the built-in one is used.
web.log.advice.noPhoto.blocked: To send posters, allow photos for the bot in {destination}, then press Check again on the destination.
web.log.advice.noPhoto.rejected: Nothing to do for this message. If it happens for every message, the poster images in Jellyfin may be damaged.
web.log.advice.noPhoto.unreadable: Check that Jellyfin can read its image files (permissions and free disk space).
web.log.advice.noPhoto.upload: Check the server's connection to api.telegram.org and the proxy in Advanced; large posters need a steady connection.
web.log.advice.late: Nothing to do if it was a one-off. If messages are often late, check the connection to Telegram and the proxy in Advanced.
